producer_report.summary: Added crates/athena-core/src/routing.rs. `route(kind, specs, changed)` decides which checks run and where each result comes from. `run_routed` calls item 4's `resolve` with the candidate SHA. run.rs now runs its checks through them. The skip stays the path rule (`skip_when_only`), so a docs, design or study job that changes a .rs file, Cargo.toml or Cargo.lock still runs fmt and clippy. The kind only turns the path rule off for config and for a missing or unrecognised kind, which never skip. `test` always runs. Every kind except build reuses a CI result through `resolve` when the capability lists fmt, clippy and test. A result for another SHA is ignored, and a red result fails with no local rerun. A build job never reuses a result and is flagged as needing the workflow's own run. The schema, athena.toml and the capability crates are unchanged. In the run path the CI source is `NoCi`, because the candidate commit is not pushed, so every check still runs locally. The workflow run for a build job is flagged in the output, not performed. Docs (ci-routing.md item 5) and CHANGELOG are updated, with no speedup claimed.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core routing`: a docs-kind job whose changed paths are only markdown or under docs/ skips fmt and clippy and still runs test.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core routing`: for each of docs, design and study, a job that changes a .rs file runs fmt and clippy (one named test per kind). The same holds when only Cargo.toml or Cargo.lock changes.
criteria_check.evidence: routing_docs_job_that_changes_rust_runs_fmt_and_clippy, routing_design_job_that_changes_rust_runs_fmt_and_clippy and routing_study_job_that_changes_rust_runs_fmt_and_clippy pass, each covering .rs, Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core routing`: a code job and a tests job run fmt, clippy and test with none skipped. A config job never has any check skipped. A build job adds the workflow's own run and never reuses a prior result.
criteria_check.evidence: routing_code_and_tests_jobs_run_every_check, routing_config_job_never_skips_a_check, routing_build_job_adds_the_workflow_run_and_never_reuses and routing_a_build_job_does_not_read_a_prior_ci_result pass. The last shows zero CI reads for build.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core routing`: a missing or unrecognised kind routes as config (fmt, clippy, test, none skipped).
criteria_check.evidence: routing_missing_or_unrecognised_kind_routes_as_config passes for None, an empty string, other, prompts and Docs.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core`: the routed path calls `resolve` with the candidate SHA. A CI result for another SHA is ignored and the check falls back to a local run. A red CI result fails the check and does not rerun locally.
criteria_check.evidence: routing_calls_resolve_with_the_candidate_sha_and_reuses_a_green_run, routing_ignores_a_ci_result_for_another_sha_and_runs_locally and routing_a_red_ci_result_fails_and_does_not_rerun_locally pass. The first records the SHA the source was asked for, and the third asserts no local run.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test` including a test that loads the committed athena.toml with the schema in the tree: athena.toml parses, and representative jobs of each kind route as 3.2 says with the committed config.
criteria_check.evidence: routing_with_the_committed_config_follows_the_table parses the committed athena.toml with `Config::parse(include_str!(...))` and routes every kind. Full `cargo test --locked` exits 0.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check`: both pass, and `cargo test` passes in full.
criteria_check.evidence: clippy with -D warnings and fmt --check are clean, and the full `cargo test --locked` exits 0.

criteria_check.criterion: The routing function is called from the job run path (run.rs) to select the checks by the plan's kind, so a reader can find the call site. Skipping still uses the path rule, and no code path skips fmt or clippy by kind alone.
criteria_check.evidence: run.rs calls `crate::routing::route(...)` and `run_routed` in the checks step. `route` skips only through `checks::skip_note` (the path rule). The kind only disables the skip, for config and unknown kinds.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/design/ci-routing.md section 10 item 5 states what was built and what is not done, and does not claim a measured speedup. Its wording keeps 'skipped as today' as the path rule. CHANGELOG.md has an entry.
criteria_check.evidence: Item 5 now has a 'Built in part' paragraph with the not-done list and 'No speedup is claimed or measured'. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] has an Added entry.

criteria_check.criterion: If the config schema or athena.toml changed, the change is limited to routing, is listed in the diff, and every crate that copies the field compiles.
criteria_check.evidence: Neither the schema nor athena.toml changed. The whole workspace compiles under clippy --all-targets.

open_issues: The run path reads no CI result yet: it uses `NoCi` because the candidate commit is not pushed. Real reuse needs that push (item 4's open part).
A build job's own workflow run is flagged in the output but not performed. Changing the CI workflow was out of scope.
The verifier's input does not yet carry `verify::reuse_statement`, so verify.rs is unchanged. The doc lists this as not done.
The listed deliverables athena.toml, config.rs, the capability crates, checks.rs, ci_result.rs, verify.rs and capability.rs needed no change.
mistakes: The first CHANGELOG edit failed because '### Added' appears 12 times. I redid it with the [Unreleased] heading as context.
My first routing.rs draft missed a Debug derive on NoCi and had a closure lifetime error in a test helper. Clippy caught both and I fixed them.
learnings: The job run's candidate commit is built with commit_tree and is not on any branch, so no CI run can exist for it today. A real CI source needs the push from ci-routing item 4's open part.

Some tests (lifecycle, common/mod.rs) configure a capability with only a `test` check. `resolve` needs all three of fmt, clippy and test, so the route reuses CI results only when the capability lists all three; otherwise everything runs locally as before.
`Snapshot::restore_to` takes &self, so the check runner can share the verifier snapshot.
The athena-core lint config denies missing_debug_implementations on public types.
The brief's Bash allowlist blocks reading files outside the working directory, including cargo's persisted output for large results.
